newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA says oil price rise an inflation danger.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA says oil price rise an inflation danger.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) said on Wednesday the rise in oil prices over the September quarter could be a danger point for inflation in the major industrial countries.

"Oil prices at end September were 30 percent higher than their level of a year ago, suggesting that they could be a danger point for inflation in the major industrial countries unless recent upward pressure subsides," the bank said in its October Bulletin, which included the September quarter report on the economy. The price of oil rose by more than 10 percent over the September quarter as tensions with Iraq resurfaced.

Oil was priced around US$24.00 a barrel in late September when the RBA prepared its report. Crude oil for November delivery closed at US$25.42 in New York on Tuesday after hitting US$25.72, a new post-war Gulf War high, in electronic trading.
